reviews.title: An excellent budget friendly case solution
reviews.comment:
Tried out this budget friendly option for my fourth pc build. I liked the aesthetic of the fans and wraparound glass, so I took a chance on it. I’m so glad I did! It’s a very clean looking case with decent room to build in. The fans are surprisingly high quality and run quite even at full speed. Seems to keep everything cool and under high temp. Cable management is decent. No instructions but the case itself is pretty straightforward.
My only complaint is the orientation of the I/O ports on top of the case. If they were rotated 45 degrees, I would be completely satisfied, but overall I am still pleased!
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Best case I’ve gotten
reviews.comment: It works really well! It looks great on my desk, all the rgb works, and it has great cooling. Its value is good, perfect size, and it’s easy to remove the glass panels. Only thing is that it looks like it has cut corners.
reviews.author: Jon Higgins

reviews.title: Good value for money but not for high end builds
reviews.comment: This is a great MATX case. Wood accents look nice build quality good for the price of the case.  Overall definite value proposition for budget / mid level builds
reviews.author: Andrew M

reviews.title: Amazing Gaming PC case, Absolutely Love it
reviews.comment: Everything about this case is absolutely amazing. The Design, Detail and Room for upgrades. Used this case for a build with a customer. Was absolutely flawless when building in. Every fan connection is daisy Chained, This it only uses one connection per 3 fans, Also the RGB connection was also daisy Chained making for an easy and fast install. Also has a ton of room for cable management. Including little pockets to house your Power supply cables. All and all, was a great and very easy pc case to build in. While including 7 Rgb fans. Would totally recommend this case to anybody wanting to build a Gaming Pc. Look great KEDIERS keep up the great Products
reviews.author: PearlofGr8Value

reviews.title: Great budget friendly case
reviews.comment: So I wanted to write a review for beginners. If youre considering this case, please read this review. The case is great if you can afford slightly better go that route. This was my first time building a pc. Self trained vigorously (Thanks youtube). The metal on this case is a bit flimsy but do-able. Also from what I have learned your only supposed to daisy chain 3 fans max. This case daisy chained four which makes to top middle fan flicker once the pc start to pick up power. This case also comes with an extra 2 pin led connector to control the fans by case button. If your motherboard is not clear on where to place don't place it anywhere. You can control the color via rbg sync software your motherboard has. Case is roomy you can definitely decorate to your hearts content. Assembly is super easy. Also the line up where gpu goes is a bit wonky. Once again for beginners, If you can get slight better do so. But if on a budget, best bang for your buck!
reviews.author: Brian Allen
